Trigger output saved by StarCraft II Editor 5.0.17 (build 98310) from
128x128 BelShirEx2 maps. Files are byte-for-byte as the Editor wrote them (CRLF, BOM on .txt),
except the hero: the maps were saved with a campaign mod whose hero unit the fixtures now call
`Zeratul`, in every file and in the tests' inputs alike. Its unit id was rewritten with it, so the
fixtures and the map compiled from `tests/fixtures/trigger-test/blueprint.json` agree:
`1379696451` is `stableObjectId("hero_zeratul")`, that blueprint's hero anchor, in
`transmission/`'s Objects, Triggers and MapScript.galaxy (and in `editor-terrain/cliffs-and-ramps/Objects`).

- `basic/`: Map Init → TriggerDebugOutput("map started!") + ObjectiveCreate("woohoo").
- `complex/`: global `unit` variable; Map Init → UnitCreate Marine at a placed
  point, store it; "dead" trigger → Unit Dies(variable) → GameOver defeat.
- `transmission/`: our generated trigger-test map, extended in the Editor with an
  `objective` variable (Last Created Objective), "Send Transmission (Campaign)"
  from VoidCampaignMissionLib, Run Trigger, and Set Objective State Completed.

`shared-ids/` isn't from those maps. It is cut from Blizzard's Liberty map `thanson01` (an older Editor's save, which numbers each element type apart, LF line ends): whole elements byte for byte, in file order, under a Root holding the item lines of the ones it files. It holds "Main Objective - Save Colonists - Complete" (Trigger `00000046`) and every call, parameter and comment it reaches, the triggers and globals it names (their elements only), and the later elements of other types that share those Ids (FunctionCall `00000013`, Comments `00000030` and `00000031`); the Trigger, Variable and FunctionCall that are all `00000029`, the Variable's initial value and one parameter whose value is it (Marine Constant Respawn's `1DFE71D6`). `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the two globals' declarations and that trigger's section; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. The splice tests also read it as a mod's library would hold it, inside a `<Library>` block with its item lines and references naming the library. No mod library in the game-data mirror files two items under one Id, though Nova Covert Ops' `NovC` and `NCMI` libraries each have an item `888E948A` (a FunctionDef in one, a Category in the other), so that library case is not cut from a save.

`template-fallback/` is cut from thanson01 the same way: three triggers that call game functions core's catalog doesn't wrap, and every element they reach, whole and in file order (LF line ends); the triggers, globals and map functions they name, their elements only (a function's parameter definitions too). "Victory Q" is an Action Queue (`ActionQueueAdd`); "Player Is In Combat" an `Or` of conditions and the event `TriggerAddEventUnitStartedAttack`; "Victory Action" four `Repeat`s with constant counts, holding `CreateUnitsAtPoint2` and `RegionRandomPoint`. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the declarations of the globals and triggers they name, then the three triggers' sections; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

`three-conditions/` is cut from thanson01 the same way: "Add Convoy Marine into Unit Group" (Trigger `49030CDB`), whose three conditions the Editor writes with a blank line between each and the next, and every element it reaches; the two globals it names, their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the globals' and the trigger's declarations, then its section; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

`comment-condition/` is cut from Legacy of the Void's ptaldarim01 (the game-data mirror's `campaigns/void.sc2campaign/`, LF line ends) the same way: "Wave Shadow FX" (Trigger `7CCCC77A`), a comment between its first and second of three conditions, which the Editor writes as nothing, and every element it reaches; the four globals and the map function (Apply Shadow Manifestation FX, with its ParamDef) it names, their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps their declarations and the trigger's, then its section; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

`mod-library-calls/` is cut from a current Editor save of a Mission that calls its Campaign Mod's library, the same way (CRLF line ends, as saved), and from that mod. The Campaign's own names are renamed throughout, in every file alike: the library is `Cmpn` (`libCmpn_`, `lib_Cmpn_`), the mod `Cmpn-Story`, its transmission function `Send Transmission (Story)`, its heroes' members `lv_zeratul` and `lv_artanis`, its conversation lines `Story03|Line…`. "Banter - Discover Air Pustule" calls three of the library's functions inside an If Then Else; "Banter - Enter Reactor Room" calls them inside the library's own If Then block, a template of its own. `Triggers`, `TriggerStrings.txt` and `MapScript.galaxy` are the map's, as `template-fallback/` cuts them (a struct global's Structure element whole, only the members the triggers name). `mods/cmpn-story/` is the mod as a Workspace holds it: `blueprint.json` declares the four functions the triggers call, as the mod's Blueprint's library interface does, and `Cmpn-Story.SC2Mod/` holds the package's elements for them, under a Root holding their item lines: each FunctionDef whole with its ParamDefs, block slots and parameter defaults (its body's calls and variables left out, since a call needs only its interface), and their strings.

`dependency-libraries/` is cut from the game's own data (the game-data mirror's `mods/missionpacks/`, an older Editor's save, LF line ends, as the game holds it, in lower case): Nova Covert Ops' mod `novacampaign.sc2mod` and Campaign Common's `campaigncommon.sc2mod`, which it depends on. Each `DocumentInfo` is whole. Nova's `Triggers` holds "Apply User Tech Choices to Player" (FunctionDef `7CC40560`) whole, with its ParamDef, its one call (to Campaign Common's `CC_ApplyTech`) and that call's Param, under a Root holding its item line (its `<SharedLib>` lines left out); `LibNovC.galaxy` and `LibNovC_h.galaxy` keep its definition and its declaration; `triggerstrings.txt` its name, grammar and hint and its parameter's name. Campaign Common's `Triggers` holds `CC_ApplyTech` (`619CB57C`) for its interface only, as `mod-library-calls/` cuts its mod: the FunctionDef with its body's calls left out, its ParamDef and that parameter's default, under a Root holding its item line; `triggerstrings.txt` their names.

`arrays/` is cut from the game's own data the same way as `dependency-libraries/` (the game-data mirror, an older Editor's saves, LF line ends, in lower case): Swarm Story Util's `campaigns/swarmstoryutil.sc2mod` and Nova Covert Ops' `mods/missionpacks/novacampaign.sc2mod`. Each `Triggers` holds whole library functions and every element they reach, in file order, under a Root holding their item lines; the library's other elements they name (globals, structure members, the constants an array's size names, triggers, structures, preset types) as their elements only, and a library function they call as its interface (its FunctionDef with its body's lines left out, its ParamDefs and their defaults). Swarm Story Util's library `281DEC45` holds "Story Add Aliased Unit" (`5F3985A1`), which indexes two arrays of one dimension, and "Character Unit" (`D28BC4EA`), which indexes an array of a structure by a call to `ZSS_CharacterIndex` before naming its member. Nova's library `NCUI` holds `NU_EquipmentInSlot` (`9C1720C8`), which indexes an array of two dimensions, and `NU_MissionSetRewards` (`AB37E133`), whose two local arrays are sized by the constant `NUC_MissionRewardsMaxCount`. Each `Lib<id>.galaxy` keeps those functions' definitions, and `triggerstrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. No `DocumentInfo` is kept: nothing the tests write calls another mod.

`library-shared-ids/` is cut from Swarm Story Util (the game-data mirror's `campaigns/swarmstoryutil.sc2mod`, an older Editor's save, which numbers each element type apart, LF line ends, in lower case) as `arrays/` is: ZSS_PlayStoryModeEntryScenes (FunctionDef `E859A89C`) whole with every element it reaches, in file order, under a Root holding its item line, and the two library functions it calls (Play Cinematic Once, Play Scripted Scene) as their interfaces; then, as `shared-ids/` keeps them, the elements of other types that share those Ids, their elements only and in file order: the FunctionCall `E859A89C` (a trigger's call to a Switch) and the Params `9BF8F4B3` and `376F6A19`, beside the function's own FunctionCalls of those Ids, and four more pairs. `triggerstrings.txt` keeps the names of the elements kept. No Galaxy is kept: the function calls Swarm Campaign's library, which the cut doesn't hold, so the tests read and write its elements only.

`indexed-values/` is cut from thanson01 as `template-fallback/` is: "Init 06 Difficulty" (Trigger `8345D960`), which sets elements of the array global `UnloadAmount` by literal indexes, and "Gather colonists prior to evacuation" (`A4CAA752`), a Repeat whose count is `UnloadAmount` indexed by a variable; every element they reach, and the globals, triggers and map function they name, their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the declarations of the globals, the map function and the triggers they name, then the two triggers' sections; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

`text-parameters/` holds two cuts. `mods/missionpacks/novacampaign.sc2mod/` is cut from the game's own data as `arrays/` is (the game-data mirror, an older Editor's save, LF line ends, in lower case): Nova's library `NovC`'s "Format Time (Campaign)" (`DFC99709`), whose two text values are `TextTimeFormat`'s format, whole with every element it reaches, in file order, under a Root holding its item line. `LibNovC.galaxy` and `LibNovC_h.galaxy` keep its definition and its declaration, `triggerstrings.txt` its name and its parameter's, and `gamestrings.txt` its two text values' words (`Param/Value/lib_NovC_<id>`). `hero-objectives/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission (CRLF line ends, as saved), as `mod-library-calls/` cuts its map: "Create Hero Survival Objectives" (FunctionDef `2F0A387D`), which creates two objectives whose descriptions are empty texts, one key holding nothing, the other absent, and every element it reaches; the struct global it sets, its Structure element whole and only the two members it names. Its heroes are renamed `Zeratul` and `Artanis` throughout, in every file alike. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the global's declaration and the function's definition; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept; `GameStrings.txt` the text values' lines.

`expressions/` holds two cuts. `mods/` is cut from the game's own data as `arrays/` is (the game-data mirror, LF line ends, in lower case): whole library functions holding expressions (`<ExpressionType>`) and every element they reach, in file order, under a Root holding their item lines; the library's other elements they name (globals, structures, preset types, triggers) as their elements only, and a library function they call as its interface (its FunctionDef with its body's lines left out, its ParamDefs and their defaults, its block slots). Campaign Common's library `ComC` (`missionpacks/campaigncommon.sc2mod`, an older Editor's save) holds `CC_LocationDataString` (`8077C217`), a string expression of two slots, one a literal; `CC_MissionObjectiveArchiveProgressSet` (`8DDD8350`), a text expression of two slots and a string one of one; and `CC_ClampProgressToMission` (`EE958875`), an int expression of two slots. Nova's `NovC` (`missionpacks/novacampaign.sc2mod`, an older Editor's save) holds `NC_DebugCampaignTechStoreStates` (`13D859D1`), two string expressions of one slot. Void Prologue's `A3DDD02B` (`voidprologue.sc2mod`, a current Editor's save) holds Create Objective (Campaign) (`A2B49061`), a text expression whose words name one of its two slots, and Progress Color (`7F5EBFCE`), an int expression and fixed ones naming a slot twice. Each `Lib<id>.galaxy` and `Lib<id>_h.galaxy` keep those functions' definitions and declarations, `triggerstrings.txt` the names of the elements kept, and `gamestrings.txt` the text expressions' words (`Param/Expression/lib_<library>_<id>`). No `DocumentInfo` is kept: Campaign Common's and Nova's functions that call another mod are written a statement at a time.

`salvage-objective/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission (CRLF line ends, as saved), as `text-parameters/hero-objectives/` is: "Create Secondary Objective (Salvage)" (FunctionDef `2C61F43A`), which creates an objective whose name is a text expression of one slot, an int arithmetic, and every element it reaches; the struct global it sets, its Structure element whole and only the two members it names. The objective's description is reworded: the save's names the Campaign's characters. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the global's declaration and the function's definition; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept; `GameStrings.txt` the expression's and the description's lines.

`function-flags/` holds six cuts. `mods/` is cut from the game's own data as `expressions/mods/` is (the game-data mirror, LF line ends, in lower case): whole library functions and every element they reach, in file order, under a Root holding their item lines, and a library function they call as its interface. Nova's `missionpacks/novacampaign.sc2mod` (an older Editor's save) holds two of its libraries. `NovC` holds `NC_ForEachArmyTechItem` (`0E4867F4`), a block with `<FlagAllowBreak>`; `NC_MissionRewardsBonusPossible` (`FEC39B0D`), a Stop Looping in it, with `NC_ArmyTechItemRequiredObjective` as its interface; Award Achievement (Campaign) (`3334E9C7`), `<Deprecated>` in its own thread; and Clear Animation (with blend time) (`8089D86E`), `<Section>` and `<Deprecated>`. `NCMI` holds Start AI Personalities For All Players (Campaign) (`040E5D6E`) and Start Campaign AI For All Players (Void) (`EE10637B`), both `<Deprecated>`. Void Prologue's `voidprologue.sc2mod` (a current Editor's save) holds Clear Animation (with blend time) (`5010B489`), `<Section>`. Each `Lib<id>.galaxy` and `Lib<id>_h.galaxy` keep those functions' definitions and declarations, and `triggerstrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

The map cuts are cut as `template-fallback/` is: each element whole, with every element it reaches, in file order, line ends as saved; the triggers, globals and map functions they name, their elements only (a function's ParamDefs too). `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the cut elements' sections in script order (a disabled trigger has none), and `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. `thanson01/` holds Player Is In Combat (FunctionDef `C11903A4`), `<FlagCall>` with a `<Label>`; Spooge Area with Overlord (`37027917`), an action with a `<Label>`; Cheat check (Trigger `6366E49D`), disabled; and Chrysalis Ping (`53F593F4`), a Stop Looping in a Repeat. `boss-functions/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission (CRLF): Boss - Switch to Airborne (FunctionDef `A43E9385`), `<FlagCreateThread>`; Boss - Is In North Half (`9FA1AC21`), `<FlagCondition>`; and Test Save Units (Trigger `5C4F25ED`), disabled, with a `<Label>`. `tech-tree/` is cut from another Mission's save (CRLF): Advance Zerg Tech Tree (FunctionDef `94DD08B9`), a Switch whose cases end in a Stop Looping, in no loop. `tstory01/` is cut from Liberty's `tstory01` in the game-data mirror (an older Editor's save, LF): Stop Music Soundtrack (Trigger `F8E7BD8A`), with a `<Label>` and a `<Section>`.

`value-forms/` holds four cuts. `mods/` is cut from the game's own data as `expressions/mods/` is (the game-data mirror, LF line ends, in lower case): whole library functions and every element they reach, in file order, under a Root holding their item lines, a library function they call as its interface, and each preset value's preset type, its element only (it names the constant the Editor generates for a value with none of its own). Void Prologue's `voidprologue.sc2mod` (a current Editor's save) holds Mission Status (`A90BDA76`), preset values with none of their own; PP_DifficultyFromIndex (`C645B4F3`), difficulties by `<ValueId>` beside a stale `<Value>`; Zoom In Planet Portrait (`C7DB17CB`), a sound link with no `<ValueId>` and Play Sound; Set Hatchery Rally Point (`4C254F3C`), an ability command with a `<ValueId>`; Display Campaign Message (`61D19D89`), sound links with `<ValueId>`s and a Switch on a preset; Difficulty Setting (`3D192DC7`), user type instances; Create Drop Pod For Zerg Building (`522AEF01`), a set of bits with its preset type; and _Zerg Drop Pod (`E6167EE6`), sets of bits that name none. Nova's `missionpacks/novacampaign.sc2mod` (an older Editor's save) holds NCMI's Campaign Player Color (`2FE7927E`), a player color by `<ValueId>`. Challenges' `challenges.sc2mod` (an older Editor's save) holds Challenge Ready Button (`89F3EBE7`), colours that aren't opaque. Each `Lib<id>.galaxy` and `Lib<id>_h.galaxy` keep those functions' definitions and declarations, `triggerstrings.txt` the names of the elements kept, and `gamestrings.txt` Display Campaign Message's text expressions' words.

The map cuts are cut as `function-flags/`'s are; a preset value's preset type is kept with it, its element only, and a structure whose members are kept, its element with only those members' lines. `sections/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission (CRLF): Boss - Is Air Phase (FunctionDef `52BEBF22`), the map's own preset values with none of their own; Boss - Set Phase (`D1C96145`), a parameter of the map's own preset type; and Complete Section (`A4BC5FD1`), a Switch on it. `thanson01/` is cut from Liberty's thanson01 (an older Editor's save, LF): BunkerGet (FunctionDef `AF6569B6`), a colour that isn't opaque; Chrysalis Tip Trigger A (Trigger `372C173B`), a sound link with a `<ValueId>` and Play Sound; GenerateColonist (FunctionDef `0FAE268C`), an actor message; and Wave Over AI Upgrades/Tips/Environment (Trigger `A33B2BC8`), a set of bits with one set. `nova05/` is cut from Nova's nova05 in the game-data mirror (LF): Add Infested Units To Rage Wave (FunctionDef `29D60EB0`), a game link parameter, and Create Terrazine Canister and Animate Tank (`FC747036`), a set of bits with two set.

`no-statements/` holds three cuts, each cut as `value-forms/`'s are. `mods/` is cut from the game's own data (the game-data mirror, LF line ends, in lower case): Void Prologue's `voidprologue.sc2mod` (a current Editor's save) holds PP_ResetTech (`09EFB9A3`), a function with no actions, and PP_StoreTechBonusAtMissionBeginning (`56D89176`), one whose only action is a comment; Challenges' `challenges.sc2mod` (an older Editor's save) holds Load Challenge Data (`C130BC3B`), which calls Bank Preload, with `CHL_InitChallengeData` as its interface and the global, preset type and preset value it names, their elements only. Each `Lib<id>.galaxy` and `Lib<id>_h.galaxy` keep those functions' definitions and declarations, and `triggerstrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. `mission/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission (CRLF): Power Area - Move Units Away (FunctionDef `2F6EE379`), a function with two parameters, a local and no actions. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps its definition; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept.

`authored-trigger/` is cut from Heart of the Swarm's zspace01 (the game-data mirror's `campaigns/swarm.sc2campaign/`, an older Editor's save, LF line ends) as `template-fallback/` is: "Hyperion Fighter Acquire Target" (Trigger `7611B84F`), initially off, with a local variable, an event, a condition and an If Then Else, and every element it reaches; the global it reads (Variable `863AD0ED`, with its initial value's Param and call) and the two map functions it calls (FunctionDefs `EDA10F5E` and `82A32553`, with the ParamDef `23A2DB1A`), their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the global's declaration and initialization, the functions' and the trigger's declarations, then the trigger's section; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. Its body transcribed as Mission Blueprint data (ADR-0026) is `../blueprint-triggers/acquire-target.json`, which the tests compile back to these files.

`custom-script/` is cut from Liberty's thorner03 (the game-data mirror's `campaigns/liberty.sc2campaign/`, a current Editor's save, LF line ends) as `template-fallback/` is: "Start Game Escort" (Trigger `19FEE8E4`), whose actions hold a Custom Script action (`AISetUnitForceMover(gv_odin, true);`), comments and a text value, and every element it reaches; the triggers and globals it names, their elements only (a global's initial value with its elements). `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the named constants' and globals' declarations under their section rules and the globals' initializations, the triggers' declarations, then the trigger's section; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept; `GameStrings.txt` its text value's line. The conversion tests (`tests/map/convert-mission-triggers.test.ts`) add it, `authored-trigger/` and the whole of `transmission/` to an imported Mission's package, convert them into its Blueprint and compile them back to the same files.

`library-globals/` is cut from a current Editor's save of a Mission that depends on its Campaign Mod (CRLF line ends, as saved), as `custom-script/` is, and from that mod, as `mod-library-calls/` is. The Campaign's own names are renamed throughout, in every file alike, as `mod-library-calls/` renames them: the library is `Cmpn` (`libCmpn_`, `lib_Cmpn_`), the mod `Cmpn-Story`, its heroes' members `lv_zeratul` and `lv_artanis`, and the Mission's own trigger and function names, to Opening, Hero Opening, Cleanup, Set Area and Difficulty Adjustments, and a unit type of the Campaign's `Marine`. "Initialization" (Trigger `C71847BE`) sets a member of the library's global Player Stats (`libCmpn_gv_playerStats.lv_chosenDifficulty = 3;`), and "Cleanup" (`9D207F5D`) reads a member of its global Hero Unit as an argument (`libCmpn_gv_heroUnit.lv_artanis`). Each is whole with every element it reaches; the triggers and map functions they name (two of each, some in disabled actions) are their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the map functions' and the triggers' declarations, then the two triggers' sections; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. `mods/cmpn-story/` is the mod as a Workspace holds it: `blueprint.json` declares the library with no functions, and `Cmpn-Story.SC2Mod/` holds the two globals and their Structures, each with only the member the triggers name, and those members' Variables whole (the Params holding their initial values aren't kept: nothing the tests read names them), under a Root holding the globals' item lines, and their names. The conversion tests add the map's cut to an imported Mission's package that depends on the mod (its script including the mod's library, as the Editor writes it), convert both triggers and compile them back to the same files.

`authoring-forms/` holds two map cuts from the game-data mirror (older Editor saves, LF line ends), each cut as `value-forms/`'s map cuts are: each trigger whole with every element it reaches, in file order, under a Root holding the item lines of the cut elements the source files; the triggers, globals (with their initial values) and map functions (with their ParamDefs) they name, their elements only; each map preset value with its preset type, its element only; each record whose members they name, its element with only those members' lines, and the members' Variables. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps only the cut triggers' sections; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept (no byte order mark: the source's first line isn't one of them); `GameStrings.txt` their text expressions' lines. `zhybrid01/` is cut from Heart of the Swarm's zhybrid01: Gas Animation Handler (Trigger `B5B872E1`), a Switch on the map's own preset values; Expansion Clear - Spawn Gas Pallets (`DEE97437`), a set of bits and a placed unit by its number; Ghost Nuke Base Entrance (`B2623B11`), placed regions by their numbers and an ability command's targeting; and Achievement: Dominated Terran Added (`1C198870`), a text expression of one slot. `pkorhal02/` is cut from Legacy of the Void's pkorhal02: Enemy Camp Init (`A2FEFBBF`), a string expression, a record's members and an Arithmetic (Integer) given a Real parameter. The authoring tool's tests (`tests/triggers/authoring-forms.test.ts`) write each trigger back through the tool and compare its Galaxy with these sections.

`map-functions/` is cut from Liberty's thanson01 (the game-data mirror, an older Editor's save, LF line ends) as `template-fallback/` is: three map functions whole, with every element they reach, in file order, under a Root holding their item lines and the global they name: Player Is In Combat (FunctionDef `C11903A4`), `<FlagCall>` returning a `bool`, with a `<Label>` and a grammar; Attack with Unburrowing Units (`137917D7`), an action with two parameters, a local and a Pick Each Unit In Group; and Create Unburrowing Units (`555E0ADA`), which calls it. The global they name (Variable `258CFDF9`, InCombatIndicator) is whole, with its initial value. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the global's declaration (its initial value is Galaxy's default, so InitGlobals sets nothing), the functions' declarations under Global Function Declarations and their definitions under Global Functions, as the Editor wrote them; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names and grammar of the elements kept. The conversion tests (`tests/map/convert-mission-triggers.test.ts`) add it to an imported Mission's package, convert the functions into its Blueprint (ADR-0026) and compile them back to the same files.

`globals-comments/` is cut from Liberty's thanson01 (the game-data mirror, an older Editor's save, LF line ends): four globals and two comments filed among its items, each whole with every element it reaches (a global's initial value with its Params), in file order, under a Root holding their item lines in the order the tree files them. ZergPlayers (Variable `819C3330`) starts at a call, EscortRouteRallyPoints (`9CC9DD0E`) is an array of 50 points, ConvoyGuardCyclingLineIndex (`E96AC71C`) an int that starts at 1, and ColonistsDeathQuota (`67430AD6`) an int that starts at a call with a difficulty's values; the comments are `510996FC` ("---") and `2E116177` ("Generate colonists"). `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the globals' declarations and their initializations in InitGlobals, under their section rule; `TriggerStrings.txt` the globals' names. The conversion tests add it to an imported Mission's package, convert the globals into its Blueprint's `triggerVariables` and the comments into its `triggers/`, and compile them back to the same files.

`folders/` is cut from Liberty's thanson01 (the game-data mirror, an older Editor's save, LF line ends) as `globals-comments/` is: the Trigger Folder "Main Objective - Reach Hanson" (Category `01D9CA01`) whole, under a Root holding its item line (in the save it sits in another folder), with what it files: its two globals whole with their initial values, and its three triggers as their elements only. `MapScript.galaxy` keeps the globals' declarations and initializations; `TriggerStrings.txt` the names of the elements kept. The conversion tests convert the folder into a Blueprint's `triggerFolders`, still filing its Kept items, and compile it back to the same files.
